items.title: Astonishing mod runs DLSS 5 on a second GPU to boost neural-rendered FPS up to 127% — game renders on one card, neural post-processing runs on the other, much like dedicated PhysX GPUs
items.description: A modder has created a ReShade add-on that runs Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on a second GPU, rendering the game on the first GPU to share the performance load.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering technology has taken the PC gaming world by storm since its recent leak and then official rollout in recent days. In what might be one of the most impressive technical applications and mods of the feature yet, one developer has showcased DLSS 5 running on a second GPU to share the processing load, rendering the game on the first GPU before applying Neural rendering at the end of the frame, thus boosting the performance of neural-rendered frames.Marcelo Guibout shared the demonstration online, with videos showing the process running on a cinematic video from The Blood of Dawnwalker, as well as Cyberpunk 2077. Guibout was quick to clarify that the videos are technical showcases, not benchmarks. However, they did share some performance figures. More exciting still, you can download the project from GitHub and try it for yourself. However, the technique does require a second display and doubles the display latency. Cyberpunk 2077 with DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Offloaded to a Second GPU — Dual RTX 5060 Ti - YouTube Watch On The above demonstration features a Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 32GB DDR5 setup with two Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GPUs, with both cards using PCIe 5.0 x8, and a display attached to each card. The ReShade add-on, dubbed MGPU Bridge, reads each finished frame before applying Nvidia's Neural rendering. "Neural rendering happens at the end of the frame: it takes a finished frame and hands a finished frame back," they explain. "That is what makes it possible to pick it up and run it somewhere else. The add-on creates its own D3D12 device on your second GPU, sends each finished frame across to it, runs DLSS-NR there, and displays the result on that card's own monitor — so nothing has to come back. The render GPU does no neural work at all and runs cooler for the same reason."Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In the TBOD demo at 1080p, they shared the following performance numbers: Swipe to scroll horizontally DLSS mode DLSS 5 off DLSS 5 on the render card DLSS 5 on the second card DLAA 67-70 44 67-70 Quality 98-99 54-55 91 Performance 127-131 59 106-107 Ultra Performance 172 69-71 157 Guibout clarified that DLSS super-resolution is running in every column of the test, with the rows showing each mode tested. The game rendered at the same internal resolution in all three columns, with the first column giving figures with DLSS 5's neural rendering switched off, representing the ceiling for performance. As you can see, running DLSS 5 on the second card in this dual-GPU setup drastically increases performance in every mode. You may like DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible Modder gets Nvidia's DLSS 5 working on AMD RDNA 4 GPUs in any DirectX 12 game DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards "The frame rates are not the finding. The slope is: what you gain by going from DLAA down to Ultra Performance, and how much of that available gain each arm keeps," Guibout explains. "Neural post-processing saturates whatever device it runs on, and it always runs at output resolution. Its cost barely falls as you drop the DLSS mode, while the render work collapses. On the render card it therefore eats a larger and larger share of every frame, and upscaling stops paying for itself: you keep about a third of what the machine actually had to give. Move it to the second card and you keep 86% of it."Other benefits include temperature reductions on the rendering card, with the first GPU running 21 degrees cooler without the neural load.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsGuibout is cautious to note this isn't a return to Nvidia's SLI technology, which would split the workload of frame rendering between two GPUs. They also noted plainly this is not Nvidia's vision for DLSS 5 and lacks the native integration of official DLSS 5 support.You can see the original demo for TBOD below: Multi-GPU DLSS Neural Rendering — Dual RTX 5060 Ti (Dawnwalker, Cinematic) - YouTube Watch On As commenters online have noted, the method seems more akin to using Nvidia's dedicated PhysX cards, with plenty of potential for gamers who have the capacity to run a dual GPU setup. The second demo features a Ryzen 5 5600 on a DDR4 system, so top-of-the-line hardware isn't required to make it happen. items.author: Stephen Warwick
items.titleZh: 惊人的mod在第二块GPU上运行DLSS 5，神经渲染帧率提升高达127%——一块显卡负责游戏渲染，另一块负责神经后处理，类似专用PhysX GPU的做法。
items.descriptionZh:
英伟达DLSS 5神经渲染技术自近期泄露并正式推出后，迅速在PC游戏圈引发热潮。如今，一位开发者展示了一项可能是该技术迄今最令人印象深刻的修改方案：让DLSS 5在第二块GPU上运行以分担处理负担，第一块GPU负责游戏渲染，在帧生成结束后再交由第二块GPU执行神经渲染，从而大幅提升启用神经渲染后的帧率。

开发者Marcelo Guibout在线上分享了演示，视频展示了该技术在《The Blood of Dawnwalker》的电影式片段以及《赛博朋克2077》中的运行情况。Guibout特意强调这些视频属于技术展示而非基准测试，不过仍给出了一些性能数据。更令人兴奋的是，该项目已发布在GitHub上，任何人都能下载自行尝试。当然，该方案要求系统配备第二台显示器，并且显示延迟会翻倍。

演示平台采用了Ryzen 7 7800X3D处理器、32GB DDR5内存，搭配两块RTX 5060 Ti 16GB显卡，两张卡均运行在PCIe 5.0 x8通道上，每张卡各连接一台显示器。这位开发者打造的ReShade插件名为“MGPU Bridge”，它的作用是读取每一帧渲染完成的画面，然后再应用英伟达的神经渲染。“神经渲染发生在帧的末端：它接收一帧已完成画面，再交还一帧已完成画面，”Guibout解释道，“这正是可以被截取并转移到别处运行的原因。插件会在你的第二块GPU上创建属于自己的D3D12设备，把每一帧完整画面发送过去，在那里运行DLSS神经渲染，并将结果直接显示在那张卡连接的显示器上——因此没有任何数据需要传回。渲染GPU完全不承担神经处理工作，也正因如此运行温度更低。”

在《The Blood of Dawnwalker》的1080p演示中，他们分享了如下性能数字（帧率区间）：

| DLSS模式 | DLSS 5关闭 | DLSS 5运行在渲染卡 | DLSS 5运行在第二卡 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DLAA | 67-70 | 44 | 67-70 |
| 质量 | 98-99 | 54-55 | 91 |
| 性能 | 127-131 | 59 | 106-107 |
| 超级性能 | 172 | 69-71 | 157 |

Guibout说明，测试中每一列都启用了DLSS超分辨率，行则代表测试的不同模式。三列中游戏都以相同内部分辨率渲染，第一列是关闭DLSS 5神经渲染时的数值，代表性能天花板。可以看出，双GPU配置下把DLSS 5放在第二张卡上运行，每种模式的性能都大幅提升。

“帧率本身不是重点，关键在于：从DLAA降到超级性能模式所能获得的增益，以及每条路径保留了多少可用增益。”Guibout解释道。“神经后处理会占满它运行的任何设备，而且始终以输出分辨率运行。随着DLSS模式降低，它的成本几乎不降，而渲染工作量却大幅缩减。因此，当它运行在渲染卡上时，神经处理会在一帧中占据越来越大的比例，超分辨率技术也就无法再带来足够回报：最终你只能保留机器原本可以输出的约三分之一性能。把它转移到第二张卡上，则可以保留86%的增益。”

另一个好处是渲染卡的温度大幅下降——在去掉神经负载后，第一张GPU的运行温度降低了21摄氏度。

值得一提的是，Guibout谨慎地指出，这并非回归英伟达的SLI技术——SLI是将帧渲染的工作量分摊到两块GPU上。他还明确表示，这也不是英伟达对DLSS 5的预期用法，缺乏官方DLSS 5支持那样的原生集成。

正如网友评论所言，这种方法更像是利用英伟达当年的专用PhysX物理卡，对于那些有能力组建双GPU系统的游戏玩家来说颇具潜力。第二个演示使用了Ryzen 5 5600处理器配合DDR4平台，说明实现该方案并不需要顶级硬件。

items.title: GTA Vice City and GTA III return to web browsers after a DMCA takedown — Open-source reverse engineering brings the classics to the web with over 100 FPS performance
items.description: You can play GTA: Vice City and GTA III in your browser right now across pretty much any modern device. The projects are compiled from source codes of the original games and are available on either DOS Zone, where you're required to upload or torrent a few assets, or Quenq.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Grand Theft Auto: Vice City has cemented itself as one of the most legendary games of all time. It originally came out in 2002 on the PS2 before making its way to the Xbox and PC a year later. Fast forward to 2026, and now the game is entirely playable in a browser window. It was actually already playable last year on DOS Zone but was quickly shut down following a DMCA strike from Take-Two. However, a different website called "Quenq" has taken up the mantle now, and it also hosts GTA III there.The project is still the same because it quite literally says DOS Zone in the pause menu. Anyhow, for a change of pace, we tried the game on a OnePlus 12; it loaded immediately and ran without any issues. Beyond keyboard/mouse and controller, the game is also compatible with touchscreen controls. We were able to seamlessly move around the world and control Tommy in both landscape and portrait orientations.You get a save game and mod manager, allowing you to upload your own files right into the browser. You can type cheats using an external keyboard as well. There's an FPS limit option before the game begins because GTA Vice City was intended to run at 30 FPS, so playing it at unlocked framerates (which this port supports) can sometimes cause bugs and physics to break. We were able to easily play the game past 100 FPS on desktop, though.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Image credit: Future Image credit: Future The project likely uses reVC — a community project that decompiles the original source code of GTA: Vice City into clean, readable C++ code. Then, WebAssembly helps translate C++ code into JavaScript that the browser can natively understand. The port should be running on WebGL 2, a JavaScript API that bypasses your browser's typical layout engine and talks directly to your GPU to execute graphics-intensive tasks.The same goes for GTA III — it's also available on Quenq, features the same controls and options (except for the mod manager), and is likely built using re3, which is the decompiled source code of GTA III. This project doesn't seem to be ripped off from DOS Zone, as there is no indication of such in the pause menu. It also runs just as well as the Vice City port, and we had no issues playing it across a bunch of devices. You may like GTA 3 and Vice City are now playable inside San Andreas Half-Life 2 can now run in your browser at over 100 FPS with save states & console support You can now play GTA V natively on a Nintendo Switch at 30 FPS thanks to unofficial Homebrew port Just out of curiosity, we checked DOS Zone and actually found both Vice City and GTA III listed there, but they require uploading the game assets. You can also just download the data through a torrent after you click a button, but the platform leaves that choice to you with clear disclaimers that they won't be responsible for piracy. It's clear that the DMCA takedown has shifted the way the platform distributes these projects, but it's still impressive that they're up, nonetheless. items.titleZh: GTA Vice City and GTA III return to web browsers after a DMCA takedown — Open-source reverse engineering brings the classics to the web with over 100 FPS performance
items.descriptionZh:
《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》——这款被誉为游戏史上最经典的作品之一——如今已能直接在浏览器窗口内完整游玩。该作最初于2002年登陆PS2，次年移植至Xbox和PC。故事时间来到2026年，一个名为“Quenq”的网站接过了让老游戏重生的接力棒，不仅提供《罪恶都市》，还一并托管了《GTA III》。此前，类似的“DOS Zone”平台曾在2025年推出过浏览器版本，但因Take-Two的DMCA（数字千年版权法）投诉而被迫下架，如今Quenq填补了这一空缺。

有趣的是，尽管托管在Quenq上，游戏的暂停菜单中仍保留了“DOS Zone”的字样，显示其技术源脉的延续性。实际测试中，编辑在一加12手机上打开游戏，页面瞬间加载且运行流畅，毫无卡顿。除了传统的键鼠和手柄操控，该版本还完美支持触摸屏，玩家无论横屏还是竖屏都能无缝控制主角汤米在开放世界中穿梭，操作手感相当顺滑。

该浏览器移植版还配有存档管理与Mod管理器，允许用户直接上传自己的游戏文件至浏览器中。玩家也能外接物理键盘输入经典秘籍。为避免物理引擎因帧率波动而崩溃，游戏启动前提供了FPS上限选项——因为《罪恶都市》原生设计锁定在30帧，解锁高帧率（该移植版支持）有时会引发物理逻辑异常。不过实测在桌面平台上，游戏能轻松突破100帧运行，体验远超原版限制。

技术内核方面，该项目极大概率基于reVC——一个将《GTA：罪恶都市》原始代码反编译为清晰可读C++代码的社区工程。随后借助WebAssembly技术，将C++代码翻译成浏览器能够原生解析的JavaScript，再通过WebGL 2这一JavaScript API绕过浏览器的常规渲染引擎，直接与GPU通信以完成高负载图形任务。至于《GTA III》，同样基于类似的re3反编译项目，界面与操作选项基本一致，只是缺少Mod管理器，且其菜单中并未显示DOS Zone的痕迹，表明并非简单复制粘贴。实测其运行表现与《罪恶都市》不相上下，在多设备上均未出现运行问题。

至于提供过浏览器版本的DOS Zone，其在经历DMCA下架后转变了分发策略：目前仍列有《罪恶都市》和《GTA III》，但页面明确要求玩家自行上传游戏资产文件，或通过点击按钮跳转至种子下载渠道，并配有清晰免责声明，表示平台方不对可能的盗版行为负责。可见法律压力重塑了这类怀旧项目的资源获取路径，但无论如何，老游戏能以如此便捷且流畅的方式在浏览器中重生，本身就是一项技术奇迹。这标志着WebAssembly、WebGL等开放网页标准已具备承载大型商业游戏的能力，未来我们或许能看到更多经典3A作品在浏览器生态中焕发新生，并衍生出跨平台即时游玩、云游戏驿站等更广阔的应用场景。

items.title: Flea market shopper uncovers $1,500 worth of Samsung SSDs inside a $30 expansion card — Three 2TB 980 Pro drives were hidden beneath an Asus Hyper M.2 heatsink
items.description: An extremely fortunate bargain hunter in Kuwait found three Samsung 980 Pro 2TB SSDs slotted inside a $30 PCIe expansion card. Each of those drives is worth between $400 and $500, so it's clear to say the thrifter struck gold during an AI rush.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Storage has gotten exponentially more expensive in the past year thanks to the ongoing component crisis. During times like these, scoring a deal feels extra special, especially when it's as bountiful as what @whateversunnyfinds (Sunny) stumbled upon in a local flea market. He hunted down a seemingly menial PCIe expansion card from Asus for $30, only to open it and find three Samsung 980 Pro 2TB SSDs already slotted inside.A post shared by Sunny (@whateversunnyfinds)A photo posted by on Each of those drives is worth at least $400 today, if not more. We found the 980 Pro 2TB listed for $444 on Amazon and $499 on Newegg, which makes three of them worth between $1,300 and $1,500 together. The expansion card holding them is an Asus Hyper M.2 x16 Gen 4 that retails for $79, so even if there were no SSDs inside, this would be a solid find. The card looks worn down but not quite beat up, while the drives honestly appear mint.An expansion card like this allows you to install extra M.2 drives in your system by using an x16 slot usually meant for GPUs. Just three of the four slots on the card were populated, so there's a chance someone took out one SSD and threw this thing in the trash. If the original owner only ever installed three, they could've forgotten to check since the heatsink covers the drives underneath.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: As for the thrifter, Sunny is from Kuwait City, and he frequents the largest flea market in the region called "Souq-al-Juma" — Arabic for "Friday Market." These open-air buildouts are common in Asian and Middle Eastern countries, but not all of them carry electronics. You usually have to visit the biggest venue on a designated day, since multiple flea markets are often propped up on the same day, to get the best, most relevant deals possible.If you're lucky enough to score something similar, the NANDpocalypse might just feel a little less crushing. We don't know the exact internal condition or health of these 980 Pros, but 6TB for $30 is such an incredible find that you wouldn't even mind if they were roughed up. It's also the exact same capacity as another person found last year while dumpster diving, so technically they got a better deal, but those were 850 Pro SATA SSDs. items.author: Hassam Nasir
items.titleZh: Flea market shopper uncovers $1,500 worth of Samsung SSDs inside a $30 expansion card — Three 2TB 980 Pro drives were hidden beneath an Asus Hyper M.2 heatsink
items.descriptionZh:
存储组件持续短缺使SSD价格在过去一年大幅上涨，能在这种环境下淘到便宜货尤为难得。一位来自科威特城的用户Sunny在本地最大的露天跳蚤市场“Souq-al-Juma”（阿拉伯语意为“星期五市场”）只花了30美元就买到一块看似不起眼的华硕PCIe扩展卡，拆开后发现里面竟插着三块三星980 Pro 2TB SSD。目前每块980 Pro 2TB在亚马逊和Newegg上的售价分别为444美元和499美元，三块合计价值约1300至1500美元。承载这些SSD的扩展卡本身是华硕Hyper M.2 x16 Gen 4，零售价约79美元，即使不带硬盘也值回票价。

这类扩展卡通过主板通常留给显卡的x16 PCIe插槽来安装额外的M.2固态硬盘。卡上有四个插槽，但只用到其中三个，推测原主可能取走了一块后弃置了整张卡，或者因为散热片遮住硬盘而忘记检查。从外观来看，扩展卡有磨损但不算严重，三块SSD则近乎全新。至于捡漏者所在的市场，这类露天市集在亚洲和中东国家很常见，但并非所有摊位都卖电子产品；想碰到最好最相关的交易，通常得在指定日子前往规模最大的场地。

今年存储价格疯涨被不少人称为“NAND危机”（NANDpocalypse），这样一次交易多少能缓解一些压力。虽然不清楚这几块980 Pro的内部健康状况或剩余寿命，但6TB仅需30美元堪称难以置信，即便稍有瑕疵也完全不亏。值得注意的是，去年曾有人通过翻垃圾箱找到同样6TB容量的固态硬盘，但那是更老的三星850 Pro SATA型号，从绝对成交价来看这次更划算。

items.title: Enthusiast says DLSS 5 pushed RTX 5090 past 600W and melted the 16-pin connector — Nvidia's neural rendering tech adds up to 50% more power draw in testing
items.description: Another RTX 5090 has gone down but this time it has something else to blame other than its own 16-pin connector. The connector is still what melted but potentially because of DLSS 5 pulling way too much power at the back end.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The RTX 5090 is no stranger to controversy thanks to the incendiary nature of its 16-pin connector. When you add something as taxing as DLSS 5, which comes with a heavy increase in power draw, to an already dangerous mix, you're just cooking up a recipe for disaster. And it seems like this recipe has likely claimed its first victim. HardOCP forum member Erek claimed their RTX 5090 fell prey to the woes of the 16-pin connector yesterday, as it melted while testing DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27.The irony is not lost on us that NBA 2K27 is the only game that officially supports DLSS 5 right now — everything else is modded — yet it still reportedly killed the user's MSI RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC, which carries a 575W TDP. However, during testing, erek reported his GPU going past 600W, with GPU-Z showing it hovering above 610W consistently, not just as a spike. Before this, the card only consumed around 450W while gaming, implying that DLSS 5 added more than 150W to the power draw. (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums)While the 16-pin connector is capable of carrying up to 600W of power, the PCIe x16 slot the card is plugged into also provides 75W on its own. So, the connector wasn't necessarily drawing over 600W alone. Tragedy struck right after as Erek's RTX 5090 started exhibiting signs of instability and eventually stopped working entirely. The owner smelled something burning and, sure enough, found the 16-pin connector pulling an age-old classic: melting.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The plastic on the connector had melted enough to bond with the cable, making it very difficult to separate the two. Once they did come undone, the damage was clearly visible, with at least five pins on the 16-pin cable scorched; one pin's housing had completely melted away. This was a yellow-tipped cable, too, meant to ensure it was plugged all the way in. Despite the fact that we only got a blurry picture of the connector on the GPU, the little yellow dot of melted plastic almost comically stands out amidst a sea of black and grey. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums) (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original We can't confirm whether DLSS 5 was actually responsible for burning Erek's card. After all, an RTX 5090 meeting its maker is a monthly tradition at this point, and the cause is usually tied to a loose fit between the connector and the cable. However, our own testing does align with how the enthusiast came up with their DLSS 5 hypothesis. We saw the MSI Lightning Z variant of the 5090, which has 2x 16-pin connectors and a 1,000W XOC BIOS, pull 800W in Control with DLSS 5 enabled. Without DLSS 5, the same GPU pulled just 691W. You may like Modders solder power cables directly to RTX 5090 PCB to eliminate notorious melting 16-pin connector We explored early DLSS 5 performance with community mods PC gamer vibe-codes a safeguard against RTX 5090 power connector failures That wasn't even the most egregious difference; in Hogwarts Legacy, we went from 480W without DLSS 5 to a whopping 720W with it enabled. That's a 50% increase in power draw for just one feature. The same game made the Founder's Edition of the 5090 pull 417W without the neural rendering tech involved, and 547W with it toggled on. So even in the standard version of the GPU with a single 16-pin connector, there's a 31% jump in power consumption because of DLSS 5. (Image credit: Future)Considering Erek's 5090 model lands somewhere between those two, and given his own testing showing a severe power budget imbalance, it's not unreasonable to assume DLSS 5 was the culprit. Had the user's GPU been acting weird before they tried the new feature, we might be having a different conversation. But it's clear that Nvidia has a lot of work to do before DLSS 5 makes its way onto the RTX 40-series down the line. Performance improvements aside, the safety concerns stemming from poor efficiency also need to be addressed.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
items.author: Hassam Nasir
items.titleZh: Enthusiast says DLSS 5 pushed RTX 5090 past 600W and melted the 16-pin connector — Nvidia's neural rendering tech adds up to 50% more power draw in testing
items.descriptionZh:
RTX 5090的16-pin电源接口问题由来已久，这个接口自推出之初就因安全缺陷备受诟病。如今，这一隐患似乎终于酿成了惨剧：一位名叫Erek的HardOCP论坛用户声称，他的MSI RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC显卡在NBA 2K27中测试DLSS 5功能时，16-pin接口再次发生熔毁。

颇具讽刺意味的是，NBA 2K27是目前唯一官方支持DLSS 5的游戏，其他所有游戏都只能通过民间mod体验这一新特性。Erek的这张显卡TDP标称575W，但他在测试中发现功耗持续超出600W，GPU-Z监测显示长期稳定在610W以上，甚至超过了该显卡原生的功耗极限。作为对照，这张卡在普通游戏场景下功耗仅约450W，这意味着DLSS 5直接让功耗飙升了超过150W。

从技术原理来看，DLSS 5的核心是基于神经渲染技术的新一代超分辨率方案，它通过GPU上的AI硬件实时预测和生成高质量帧，在提升画面表现的同时，也会让显卡核心的运算密度大幅提升，从而带来显著的功耗增长。虽然从接口理论上讲，16-pin接口本身可承载600W功率，加上PCIe x16插槽还能提供75W，接口并未单纯超过规格上限，但这并不能拯救Erek的显卡。在功耗飙升之后，他的显卡开始出现不稳定迹象并最终彻底报废。他闻到了烧焦的味道，拆开后发现16-pin接口已经完成了一项"保留节目"——塑料外壳因高温熔化，与线缆牢牢粘合在一起，极难分离。当两者终于被分开时，损伤触目惊心：16-pin线缆上至少有五个针脚被烧焦，其中一个针脚的塑料外壳甚至完全熔化殆尽。特别值得注意的是，这根线缆具有黄色标记设计——本意是为了帮助用户确认插头完全插入到位，以避免接触不良，但如今这枚黄色标记熔解后在黑色线缆中显得格外"抢眼"，成了这场事故中最讽刺的一幕。

Tom's Hardware的编辑指出，我们无法百分之百确认DLSS 5就是烧毁Erek显卡的元凶。RTX 5090的熔毁事故几乎每个月都在发生，通常与连接器和线缆之间未能完全插紧有关。然而，Tom's Hardware自己的测试结果与Erek的DLSS 5功耗假说高度吻合。他们对RTX 5090 Lightning Zap版本——该版本配备双16-pin接口和1000W XOC BIOS——进行了测试，在Control游戏中开启DLSS 5后功耗达到800W，而未开启时仅为691W。更夸张的差异出现在《霍格沃茨之遗》中：未开启DLSS 5时功耗为480W，开启后飙升至720W——仅凭这一项功能，功耗就增加了50%。同一款游戏下，公版RTX 5090在开启DLSS 5时的功耗从417W跃升至547W，涨幅也达到了31%。考虑到Erek的显卡型号定位介于以上两种配置之间，其功率预算失衡幅度与其他情况高度一致，因此断言DLSS 5是"真凶"并非不合理的推测。

性能提升固然令人兴奋，但DLSS 5所带来的功耗爆炸和安全隐患给Nvidia敲响了警钟。在DLSS 5未来下放到RTX 40系列之前，Nvidia需要解决的核心问题不仅仅是性能瓶颈，更是由其能效不足所衍生出的安全性担忧。电源接口熔断对用户造成的损失，远比帧率提升带来的愉悦感要沉重得多。

history.title: Astonishing mod runs DLSS 5 on a second GPU to boost neural-rendered FPS up to 127% — game renders on one card, neural post-processing runs on the other, much like dedicated PhysX GPUs
history.description: A modder has created a ReShade add-on that runs Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on a second GPU, rendering the game on the first GPU to share the performance load.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering technology has taken the PC gaming world by storm since its recent leak and then official rollout in recent days. In what might be one of the most impressive technical applications and mods of the feature yet, one developer has showcased DLSS 5 running on a second GPU to share the processing load, rendering the game on the first GPU before applying Neural rendering at the end of the frame, thus boosting the performance of neural-rendered frames.Marcelo Guibout shared the demonstration online, with videos showing the process running on a cinematic video from The Blood of Dawnwalker, as well as Cyberpunk 2077. Guibout was quick to clarify that the videos are technical showcases, not benchmarks. However, they did share some performance figures. More exciting still, you can download the project from GitHub and try it for yourself. However, the technique does require a second display and doubles the display latency. Cyberpunk 2077 with DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Offloaded to a Second GPU — Dual RTX 5060 Ti - YouTube Watch On The above demonstration features a Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 32GB DDR5 setup with two Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GPUs, with both cards using PCIe 5.0 x8, and a display attached to each card. The ReShade add-on, dubbed MGPU Bridge, reads each finished frame before applying Nvidia's Neural rendering. "Neural rendering happens at the end of the frame: it takes a finished frame and hands a finished frame back," they explain. "That is what makes it possible to pick it up and run it somewhere else. The add-on creates its own D3D12 device on your second GPU, sends each finished frame across to it, runs DLSS-NR there, and displays the result on that card's own monitor — so nothing has to come back. The render GPU does no neural work at all and runs cooler for the same reason."Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In the TBOD demo at 1080p, they shared the following performance numbers: Swipe to scroll horizontally DLSS mode DLSS 5 off DLSS 5 on the render card DLSS 5 on the second card DLAA 67-70 44 67-70 Quality 98-99 54-55 91 Performance 127-131 59 106-107 Ultra Performance 172 69-71 157 Guibout clarified that DLSS super-resolution is running in every column of the test, with the rows showing each mode tested. The game rendered at the same internal resolution in all three columns, with the first column giving figures with DLSS 5's neural rendering switched off, representing the ceiling for performance. As you can see, running DLSS 5 on the second card in this dual-GPU setup drastically increases performance in every mode. You may like DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible Modder gets Nvidia's DLSS 5 working on AMD RDNA 4 GPUs in any DirectX 12 game DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards "The frame rates are not the finding. The slope is: what you gain by going from DLAA down to Ultra Performance, and how much of that available gain each arm keeps," Guibout explains. "Neural post-processing saturates whatever device it runs on, and it always runs at output resolution. Its cost barely falls as you drop the DLSS mode, while the render work collapses. On the render card it therefore eats a larger and larger share of every frame, and upscaling stops paying for itself: you keep about a third of what the machine actually had to give. Move it to the second card and you keep 86% of it."Other benefits include temperature reductions on the rendering card, with the first GPU running 21 degrees cooler without the neural load.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsGuibout is cautious to note this isn't a return to Nvidia's SLI technology, which would split the workload of frame rendering between two GPUs. They also noted plainly this is not Nvidia's vision for DLSS 5 and lacks the native integration of official DLSS 5 support.You can see the original demo for TBOD below: Multi-GPU DLSS Neural Rendering — Dual RTX 5060 Ti (Dawnwalker, Cinematic) - YouTube Watch On As commenters online have noted, the method seems more akin to using Nvidia's dedicated PhysX cards, with plenty of potential for gamers who have the capacity to run a dual GPU setup. The second demo features a Ryzen 5 5600 on a DDR4 system, so top-of-the-line hardware isn't required to make it happen. history.author: Stephen Warwick
history.titleZh: 惊人的mod在第二块GPU上运行DLSS 5，神经渲染帧率提升高达127%——一块显卡负责游戏渲染，另一块负责神经后处理，类似专用PhysX GPU的做法。
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达DLSS 5神经渲染技术自近期泄露并正式推出后，迅速在PC游戏圈引发热潮。如今，一位开发者展示了一项可能是该技术迄今最令人印象深刻的修改方案：让DLSS 5在第二块GPU上运行以分担处理负担，第一块GPU负责游戏渲染，在帧生成结束后再交由第二块GPU执行神经渲染，从而大幅提升启用神经渲染后的帧率。

开发者Marcelo Guibout在线上分享了演示，视频展示了该技术在《The Blood of Dawnwalker》的电影式片段以及《赛博朋克2077》中的运行情况。Guibout特意强调这些视频属于技术展示而非基准测试，不过仍给出了一些性能数据。更令人兴奋的是，该项目已发布在GitHub上，任何人都能下载自行尝试。当然，该方案要求系统配备第二台显示器，并且显示延迟会翻倍。

演示平台采用了Ryzen 7 7800X3D处理器、32GB DDR5内存，搭配两块RTX 5060 Ti 16GB显卡，两张卡均运行在PCIe 5.0 x8通道上，每张卡各连接一台显示器。这位开发者打造的ReShade插件名为“MGPU Bridge”，它的作用是读取每一帧渲染完成的画面，然后再应用英伟达的神经渲染。“神经渲染发生在帧的末端：它接收一帧已完成画面，再交还一帧已完成画面，”Guibout解释道，“这正是可以被截取并转移到别处运行的原因。插件会在你的第二块GPU上创建属于自己的D3D12设备，把每一帧完整画面发送过去，在那里运行DLSS神经渲染，并将结果直接显示在那张卡连接的显示器上——因此没有任何数据需要传回。渲染GPU完全不承担神经处理工作，也正因如此运行温度更低。”

在《The Blood of Dawnwalker》的1080p演示中，他们分享了如下性能数字（帧率区间）：

| DLSS模式 | DLSS 5关闭 | DLSS 5运行在渲染卡 | DLSS 5运行在第二卡 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DLAA | 67-70 | 44 | 67-70 |
| 质量 | 98-99 | 54-55 | 91 |
| 性能 | 127-131 | 59 | 106-107 |
| 超级性能 | 172 | 69-71 | 157 |

Guibout说明，测试中每一列都启用了DLSS超分辨率，行则代表测试的不同模式。三列中游戏都以相同内部分辨率渲染，第一列是关闭DLSS 5神经渲染时的数值，代表性能天花板。可以看出，双GPU配置下把DLSS 5放在第二张卡上运行，每种模式的性能都大幅提升。

“帧率本身不是重点，关键在于：从DLAA降到超级性能模式所能获得的增益，以及每条路径保留了多少可用增益。”Guibout解释道。“神经后处理会占满它运行的任何设备，而且始终以输出分辨率运行。随着DLSS模式降低，它的成本几乎不降，而渲染工作量却大幅缩减。因此，当它运行在渲染卡上时，神经处理会在一帧中占据越来越大的比例，超分辨率技术也就无法再带来足够回报：最终你只能保留机器原本可以输出的约三分之一性能。把它转移到第二张卡上，则可以保留86%的增益。”

另一个好处是渲染卡的温度大幅下降——在去掉神经负载后，第一张GPU的运行温度降低了21摄氏度。

值得一提的是，Guibout谨慎地指出，这并非回归英伟达的SLI技术——SLI是将帧渲染的工作量分摊到两块GPU上。他还明确表示，这也不是英伟达对DLSS 5的预期用法，缺乏官方DLSS 5支持那样的原生集成。

正如网友评论所言，这种方法更像是利用英伟达当年的专用PhysX物理卡，对于那些有能力组建双GPU系统的游戏玩家来说颇具潜力。第二个演示使用了Ryzen 5 5600处理器配合DDR4平台，说明实现该方案并不需要顶级硬件。

history.title: GTA Vice City and GTA III return to web browsers after a DMCA takedown — Open-source reverse engineering brings the classics to the web with over 100 FPS performance
history.description: You can play GTA: Vice City and GTA III in your browser right now across pretty much any modern device. The projects are compiled from source codes of the original games and are available on either DOS Zone, where you're required to upload or torrent a few assets, or Quenq.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Grand Theft Auto: Vice City has cemented itself as one of the most legendary games of all time. It originally came out in 2002 on the PS2 before making its way to the Xbox and PC a year later. Fast forward to 2026, and now the game is entirely playable in a browser window. It was actually already playable last year on DOS Zone but was quickly shut down following a DMCA strike from Take-Two. However, a different website called "Quenq" has taken up the mantle now, and it also hosts GTA III there.The project is still the same because it quite literally says DOS Zone in the pause menu. Anyhow, for a change of pace, we tried the game on a OnePlus 12; it loaded immediately and ran without any issues. Beyond keyboard/mouse and controller, the game is also compatible with touchscreen controls. We were able to seamlessly move around the world and control Tommy in both landscape and portrait orientations.You get a save game and mod manager, allowing you to upload your own files right into the browser. You can type cheats using an external keyboard as well. There's an FPS limit option before the game begins because GTA Vice City was intended to run at 30 FPS, so playing it at unlocked framerates (which this port supports) can sometimes cause bugs and physics to break. We were able to easily play the game past 100 FPS on desktop, though.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Image credit: Future Image credit: Future The project likely uses reVC — a community project that decompiles the original source code of GTA: Vice City into clean, readable C++ code. Then, WebAssembly helps translate C++ code into JavaScript that the browser can natively understand. The port should be running on WebGL 2, a JavaScript API that bypasses your browser's typical layout engine and talks directly to your GPU to execute graphics-intensive tasks.The same goes for GTA III — it's also available on Quenq, features the same controls and options (except for the mod manager), and is likely built using re3, which is the decompiled source code of GTA III. This project doesn't seem to be ripped off from DOS Zone, as there is no indication of such in the pause menu. It also runs just as well as the Vice City port, and we had no issues playing it across a bunch of devices. You may like GTA 3 and Vice City are now playable inside San Andreas Half-Life 2 can now run in your browser at over 100 FPS with save states & console support You can now play GTA V natively on a Nintendo Switch at 30 FPS thanks to unofficial Homebrew port Just out of curiosity, we checked DOS Zone and actually found both Vice City and GTA III listed there, but they require uploading the game assets. You can also just download the data through a torrent after you click a button, but the platform leaves that choice to you with clear disclaimers that they won't be responsible for piracy. It's clear that the DMCA takedown has shifted the way the platform distributes these projects, but it's still impressive that they're up, nonetheless. history.author: Hassam Nasir
history.titleZh: GTA Vice City and GTA III return to web browsers after a DMCA takedown — Open-source reverse engineering brings the classics to the web with over 100 FPS performance
history.descriptionZh:
《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》——这款被誉为游戏史上最经典的作品之一——如今已能直接在浏览器窗口内完整游玩。该作最初于2002年登陆PS2，次年移植至Xbox和PC。故事时间来到2026年，一个名为“Quenq”的网站接过了让老游戏重生的接力棒，不仅提供《罪恶都市》，还一并托管了《GTA III》。此前，类似的“DOS Zone”平台曾在2025年推出过浏览器版本，但因Take-Two的DMCA（数字千年版权法）投诉而被迫下架，如今Quenq填补了这一空缺。

有趣的是，尽管托管在Quenq上，游戏的暂停菜单中仍保留了“DOS Zone”的字样，显示其技术源脉的延续性。实际测试中，编辑在一加12手机上打开游戏，页面瞬间加载且运行流畅，毫无卡顿。除了传统的键鼠和手柄操控，该版本还完美支持触摸屏，玩家无论横屏还是竖屏都能无缝控制主角汤米在开放世界中穿梭，操作手感相当顺滑。

该浏览器移植版还配有存档管理与Mod管理器，允许用户直接上传自己的游戏文件至浏览器中。玩家也能外接物理键盘输入经典秘籍。为避免物理引擎因帧率波动而崩溃，游戏启动前提供了FPS上限选项——因为《罪恶都市》原生设计锁定在30帧，解锁高帧率（该移植版支持）有时会引发物理逻辑异常。不过实测在桌面平台上，游戏能轻松突破100帧运行，体验远超原版限制。

技术内核方面，该项目极大概率基于reVC——一个将《GTA：罪恶都市》原始代码反编译为清晰可读C++代码的社区工程。随后借助WebAssembly技术，将C++代码翻译成浏览器能够原生解析的JavaScript，再通过WebGL 2这一JavaScript API绕过浏览器的常规渲染引擎，直接与GPU通信以完成高负载图形任务。至于《GTA III》，同样基于类似的re3反编译项目，界面与操作选项基本一致，只是缺少Mod管理器，且其菜单中并未显示DOS Zone的痕迹，表明并非简单复制粘贴。实测其运行表现与《罪恶都市》不相上下，在多设备上均未出现运行问题。

至于提供过浏览器版本的DOS Zone，其在经历DMCA下架后转变了分发策略：目前仍列有《罪恶都市》和《GTA III》，但页面明确要求玩家自行上传游戏资产文件，或通过点击按钮跳转至种子下载渠道，并配有清晰免责声明，表示平台方不对可能的盗版行为负责。可见法律压力重塑了这类怀旧项目的资源获取路径，但无论如何，老游戏能以如此便捷且流畅的方式在浏览器中重生，本身就是一项技术奇迹。这标志着WebAssembly、WebGL等开放网页标准已具备承载大型商业游戏的能力，未来我们或许能看到更多经典3A作品在浏览器生态中焕发新生，并衍生出跨平台即时游玩、云游戏驿站等更广阔的应用场景。

history.title: Flea market shopper uncovers $1,500 worth of Samsung SSDs inside a $30 expansion card — Three 2TB 980 Pro drives were hidden beneath an Asus Hyper M.2 heatsink
history.description: An extremely fortunate bargain hunter in Kuwait found three Samsung 980 Pro 2TB SSDs slotted inside a $30 PCIe expansion card. Each of those drives is worth between $400 and $500, so it's clear to say the thrifter struck gold during an AI rush.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Storage has gotten exponentially more expensive in the past year thanks to the ongoing component crisis. During times like these, scoring a deal feels extra special, especially when it's as bountiful as what @whateversunnyfinds (Sunny) stumbled upon in a local flea market. He hunted down a seemingly menial PCIe expansion card from Asus for $30, only to open it and find three Samsung 980 Pro 2TB SSDs already slotted inside.A post shared by Sunny (@whateversunnyfinds)A photo posted by on Each of those drives is worth at least $400 today, if not more. We found the 980 Pro 2TB listed for $444 on Amazon and $499 on Newegg, which makes three of them worth between $1,300 and $1,500 together. The expansion card holding them is an Asus Hyper M.2 x16 Gen 4 that retails for $79, so even if there were no SSDs inside, this would be a solid find. The card looks worn down but not quite beat up, while the drives honestly appear mint.An expansion card like this allows you to install extra M.2 drives in your system by using an x16 slot usually meant for GPUs. Just three of the four slots on the card were populated, so there's a chance someone took out one SSD and threw this thing in the trash. If the original owner only ever installed three, they could've forgotten to check since the heatsink covers the drives underneath.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: As for the thrifter, Sunny is from Kuwait City, and he frequents the largest flea market in the region called "Souq-al-Juma" — Arabic for "Friday Market." These open-air buildouts are common in Asian and Middle Eastern countries, but not all of them carry electronics. You usually have to visit the biggest venue on a designated day, since multiple flea markets are often propped up on the same day, to get the best, most relevant deals possible.If you're lucky enough to score something similar, the NANDpocalypse might just feel a little less crushing. We don't know the exact internal condition or health of these 980 Pros, but 6TB for $30 is such an incredible find that you wouldn't even mind if they were roughed up. It's also the exact same capacity as another person found last year while dumpster diving, so technically they got a better deal, but those were 850 Pro SATA SSDs. history.titleZh: Flea market shopper uncovers $1,500 worth of Samsung SSDs inside a $30 expansion card — Three 2TB 980 Pro drives were hidden beneath an Asus Hyper M.2 heatsink
history.descriptionZh:
存储组件持续短缺使SSD价格在过去一年大幅上涨，能在这种环境下淘到便宜货尤为难得。一位来自科威特城的用户Sunny在本地最大的露天跳蚤市场“Souq-al-Juma”（阿拉伯语意为“星期五市场”）只花了30美元就买到一块看似不起眼的华硕PCIe扩展卡，拆开后发现里面竟插着三块三星980 Pro 2TB SSD。目前每块980 Pro 2TB在亚马逊和Newegg上的售价分别为444美元和499美元，三块合计价值约1300至1500美元。承载这些SSD的扩展卡本身是华硕Hyper M.2 x16 Gen 4，零售价约79美元，即使不带硬盘也值回票价。

这类扩展卡通过主板通常留给显卡的x16 PCIe插槽来安装额外的M.2固态硬盘。卡上有四个插槽，但只用到其中三个，推测原主可能取走了一块后弃置了整张卡，或者因为散热片遮住硬盘而忘记检查。从外观来看，扩展卡有磨损但不算严重，三块SSD则近乎全新。至于捡漏者所在的市场，这类露天市集在亚洲和中东国家很常见，但并非所有摊位都卖电子产品；想碰到最好最相关的交易，通常得在指定日子前往规模最大的场地。

今年存储价格疯涨被不少人称为“NAND危机”（NANDpocalypse），这样一次交易多少能缓解一些压力。虽然不清楚这几块980 Pro的内部健康状况或剩余寿命，但6TB仅需30美元堪称难以置信，即便稍有瑕疵也完全不亏。值得注意的是，去年曾有人通过翻垃圾箱找到同样6TB容量的固态硬盘，但那是更老的三星850 Pro SATA型号，从绝对成交价来看这次更划算。

history.title: Enthusiast says DLSS 5 pushed RTX 5090 past 600W and melted the 16-pin connector — Nvidia's neural rendering tech adds up to 50% more power draw in testing
history.description: Another RTX 5090 has gone down but this time it has something else to blame other than its own 16-pin connector. The connector is still what melted but potentially because of DLSS 5 pulling way too much power at the back end.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The RTX 5090 is no stranger to controversy thanks to the incendiary nature of its 16-pin connector. When you add something as taxing as DLSS 5, which comes with a heavy increase in power draw, to an already dangerous mix, you're just cooking up a recipe for disaster. And it seems like this recipe has likely claimed its first victim. HardOCP forum member Erek claimed their RTX 5090 fell prey to the woes of the 16-pin connector yesterday, as it melted while testing DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27.The irony is not lost on us that NBA 2K27 is the only game that officially supports DLSS 5 right now — everything else is modded — yet it still reportedly killed the user's MSI RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC, which carries a 575W TDP. However, during testing, erek reported his GPU going past 600W, with GPU-Z showing it hovering above 610W consistently, not just as a spike. Before this, the card only consumed around 450W while gaming, implying that DLSS 5 added more than 150W to the power draw. (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums)While the 16-pin connector is capable of carrying up to 600W of power, the PCIe x16 slot the card is plugged into also provides 75W on its own. So, the connector wasn't necessarily drawing over 600W alone. Tragedy struck right after as Erek's RTX 5090 started exhibiting signs of instability and eventually stopped working entirely. The owner smelled something burning and, sure enough, found the 16-pin connector pulling an age-old classic: melting.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The plastic on the connector had melted enough to bond with the cable, making it very difficult to separate the two. Once they did come undone, the damage was clearly visible, with at least five pins on the 16-pin cable scorched; one pin's housing had completely melted away. This was a yellow-tipped cable, too, meant to ensure it was plugged all the way in. Despite the fact that we only got a blurry picture of the connector on the GPU, the little yellow dot of melted plastic almost comically stands out amidst a sea of black and grey. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums) (Image credit: erek on HardOCP Forums) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original We can't confirm whether DLSS 5 was actually responsible for burning Erek's card. After all, an RTX 5090 meeting its maker is a monthly tradition at this point, and the cause is usually tied to a loose fit between the connector and the cable. However, our own testing does align with how the enthusiast came up with their DLSS 5 hypothesis. We saw the MSI Lightning Z variant of the 5090, which has 2x 16-pin connectors and a 1,000W XOC BIOS, pull 800W in Control with DLSS 5 enabled. Without DLSS 5, the same GPU pulled just 691W. You may like Modders solder power cables directly to RTX 5090 PCB to eliminate notorious melting 16-pin connector We explored early DLSS 5 performance with community mods PC gamer vibe-codes a safeguard against RTX 5090 power connector failures That wasn't even the most egregious difference; in Hogwarts Legacy, we went from 480W without DLSS 5 to a whopping 720W with it enabled. That's a 50% increase in power draw for just one feature. The same game made the Founder's Edition of the 5090 pull 417W without the neural rendering tech involved, and 547W with it toggled on. So even in the standard version of the GPU with a single 16-pin connector, there's a 31% jump in power consumption because of DLSS 5. (Image credit: Future)Considering Erek's 5090 model lands somewhere between those two, and given his own testing showing a severe power budget imbalance, it's not unreasonable to assume DLSS 5 was the culprit. Had the user's GPU been acting weird before they tried the new feature, we might be having a different conversation. But it's clear that Nvidia has a lot of work to do before DLSS 5 makes its way onto the RTX 40-series down the line. history.author: Hassam Nasir
history.titleZh: Enthusiast says DLSS 5 pushed RTX 5090 past 600W and melted the 16-pin connector — Nvidia's neural rendering tech adds up to 50% more power draw in testing
history.descriptionZh:
RTX 5090的16-pin电源接口问题由来已久，这个接口自推出之初就因安全缺陷备受诟病。如今，这一隐患似乎终于酿成了惨剧：一位名叫Erek的HardOCP论坛用户声称，他的MSI RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC显卡在NBA 2K27中测试DLSS 5功能时，16-pin接口再次发生熔毁。

颇具讽刺意味的是，NBA 2K27是目前唯一官方支持DLSS 5的游戏，其他所有游戏都只能通过民间mod体验这一新特性。Erek的这张显卡TDP标称575W，但他在测试中发现功耗持续超出600W，GPU-Z监测显示长期稳定在610W以上，甚至超过了该显卡原生的功耗极限。作为对照，这张卡在普通游戏场景下功耗仅约450W，这意味着DLSS 5直接让功耗飙升了超过150W。

从技术原理来看，DLSS 5的核心是基于神经渲染技术的新一代超分辨率方案，它通过GPU上的AI硬件实时预测和生成高质量帧，在提升画面表现的同时，也会让显卡核心的运算密度大幅提升，从而带来显著的功耗增长。虽然从接口理论上讲，16-pin接口本身可承载600W功率，加上PCIe x16插槽还能提供75W，接口并未单纯超过规格上限，但这并不能拯救Erek的显卡。在功耗飙升之后，他的显卡开始出现不稳定迹象并最终彻底报废。他闻到了烧焦的味道，拆开后发现16-pin接口已经完成了一项"保留节目"——塑料外壳因高温熔化，与线缆牢牢粘合在一起，极难分离。当两者终于被分开时，损伤触目惊心：16-pin线缆上至少有五个针脚被烧焦，其中一个针脚的塑料外壳甚至完全熔化殆尽。特别值得注意的是，这根线缆具有黄色标记设计——本意是为了帮助用户确认插头完全插入到位，以避免接触不良，但如今这枚黄色标记熔解后在黑色线缆中显得格外"抢眼"，成了这场事故中最讽刺的一幕。

Tom's Hardware的编辑指出，我们无法百分之百确认DLSS 5就是烧毁Erek显卡的元凶。RTX 5090的熔毁事故几乎每个月都在发生，通常与连接器和线缆之间未能完全插紧有关。然而，Tom's Hardware自己的测试结果与Erek的DLSS 5功耗假说高度吻合。他们对RTX 5090 Lightning Zap版本——该版本配备双16-pin接口和1000W XOC BIOS——进行了测试，在Control游戏中开启DLSS 5后功耗达到800W，而未开启时仅为691W。更夸张的差异出现在《霍格沃茨之遗》中：未开启DLSS 5时功耗为480W，开启后飙升至720W——仅凭这一项功能，功耗就增加了50%。同一款游戏下，公版RTX 5090在开启DLSS 5时的功耗从417W跃升至547W，涨幅也达到了31%。考虑到Erek的显卡型号定位介于以上两种配置之间，其功率预算失衡幅度与其他情况高度一致，因此断言DLSS 5是"真凶"并非不合理的推测。

性能提升固然令人兴奋，但DLSS 5所带来的功耗爆炸和安全隐患给Nvidia敲响了警钟。在DLSS 5未来下放到RTX 40系列之前，Nvidia需要解决的核心问题不仅仅是性能瓶颈，更是由其能效不足所衍生出的安全性担忧。电源接口熔断对用户造成的损失，远比帧率提升带来的愉悦感要沉重得多。
